# Parley v0.1.48

Three changes: an allowed network rule now reaches Codex's sandbox and there
is a built-in profile that allows it, the Codex review states what your own
Codex config sets for approvals, and the toolbar's Return item is now Answer
and appears only when something is waiting for one.

## Network reaches Codex, and Flexible + network

A profile could say Use network: Allowed by profile, but nothing carried
that to Codex: its built-in `:workspace` and `:read-only` profiles have no
network, so every network command escalated and the review's word was false.
The Codex-native permissions table now carries `network.enabled = true` when
the profile allows network access, and a new built-in profile, **Flexible +
network**, is Flexible with that rule allowed, for panes that fetch packages
or check URLs.

Only Codex has a network sandbox Parley can set. For Claude, Agy and Copilot
the Vendor Enforcement line now says so: an allowed network rule is not
carried and network use is the vendor's own prompt. For Codex it says whether
network is enabled in the sandbox or stays off with escalation.

## The Codex review reads your own approvals setting

Under Approvals, a Codex host review now shows what your Codex configuration
resolves for `approvals_reviewer` in that folder, read through the same
bounded config query the start check already runs. `auto_review` is shown in
orange with the reason: Codex then sends escalations to its automatic reviewer
and shows no prompt, whichever you choose in Parley. If the config sets none,
the line says the choice above decides. A read failure is worded as one.

## Return is Answer, and only when it applies

The toolbar item was called Return and sat greyed out most of the time. It is
the manual completion of an Ask the active pane was asked, for a target that
printed its reply without running `parley answer`. It is now called
**Answer**, appears only while the pane holds an unanswered Ask, and its item
reads "Answer <asker>…". The pane header, the app menu, Status Center, Help,
the protocol text and the docs use the same word. Nothing about what it does
changed: it completes the waiting command directly and pastes nothing.

## Compatibility

Agent protocol semantics unchanged and the version stays at 32; one protocol
sentence names Answer instead of Return. The built-in profile list gains one
entry; remembered selections and custom profiles are unaffected. Existing
Codex panes pick up the network table on their next start or restart.

Validated: 348 native checks, 53 Node tests, public scan, platform scan and
build. The network check was watched failing with the table key dropped.

Not driven by hand: a Codex pane on Flexible + network running a network
command, the config line in the review, and the Answer item in the running
app. All three are in `docs/test-scenarios.md` (P2.9 and P2.5).

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
